Can you provide an "audit pack" (SAML sample, SCIM export, mapping matrix) and a short write-up describing how role ownership and privilege reviews are performed? Our deadline to submit to the assessor is 10/13.

Alex — final deliverable attached. Summary of items delivered:

- saml-assertion-sample.xml (sanitized): contains NameID and AttributeStatement block. Attributes are annotated inline with comments marking REQUIRED vs OPTIONAL.
- scim-delta-20250930.csv: provision/demotion/deprovision events; PII redacted where appropriate.
- role-mapping-matrix.xlsx: includes explicit owner emails and last attestation dates (see column H). The data-analyst role owner is Carla Mendes <carla.mendes@redwood.com>; owner performs quarterly attestations and is listed in the matrix.

A couple of process notes for your assessor: we enforce least-privilege via a combination of automated pruning jobs, owner-driven quarterly attestation, and an escalation path to security ops when orphaned privileges are detected. We also keep a secure record of attestation responses in the compliance vault (retained 3 years).

If the assessor needs an unredacted SAML assertion or logs under an NDA, we can provide those via secure share and a narrow access window.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
